glosses: lit; lighted (burning, especially with a small, controlled fire)

examples.text: A luz da sala está acesa.
examples.en: The light is on in the living room.

examples.text: Tom dorme com a luz acesa.
examples.en: Tom sleeps with the light on.

examples.text: As luzes estão acesas na cozinha.
examples.en: The lights are on in the kitchen.

examples.text: A luz estava acesa na cozinha.
examples.en: The light was on in the kitchen.
